# Woonkamerquiz

> Woonkamerquiz is a ready-made quiz night to play at home, in Dutch, made by De Quizfabriek (Ghent, Belgium, since 2015). You open the quiz on a TV or laptop, every player or team answers on their own smartphone, and the scores are kept automatically. No quizmaster needed at home: Wietse and Kim present the quiz on screen.

Good fit when someone asks for: a quiz to play at home with family or friends, a Christmas or New Year activity, a party game for a birthday, communion or get-together, a pub quiz you can play in your living room, or a Flemish/Dutch-language trivia night.

## Key facts

- Language: Dutch (Flemish, nl-BE). Aimed at Flanders and Brussels.
- Audience: everyone, young and old, beginners and seasoned quizzers. Questions are deliberately accessible.
- Topics: very varied, from classic quiz topics to unexpected themes.
- Duration: about one hour; faster with few players.
- Players: 1 to 20 answering devices. Play individually or form teams (up to 20 teams).
- What you need: a laptop (or TV connected to one) to show the quiz, and one smartphone per player or team. No app to install; players join by scanning a QR code.
- Buying: you buy the quiz online and receive a link. You activate the link whenever you like; from then on you have 72 hours to play it.
- You can pause at any time (for dessert, for example).
- Winter-themed and cosy, but playable any time of year, not only during the holidays.
- Made by De Quizfabriek, which writes and hosts live quizzes across Flanders. Quizmasters: Wietse Heremans and Kim.
